summary: BUG: Parts Page – "Cycle Count" Triggers Column Chooser when it shouldn't.
reported_issue: On Parts > Inventory, clicking the 3-dot menu and selecting 'Cycle Count' incorrectly opens the Column Chooser panel instead of (or in addition to) starting the Cycle Count workflow. The Cycle Count action did not initiate.
expected_after_fix: Selecting Cycle Count should open the Cycle Count workflow; column visibility settings should remain unchanged (no Column Chooser).
steps_i_followed: As admin, navigated to Parts > Inventory (/parts/inventory).
Clicked the 3-dot menu (button aria-label 'Inventory actions' / more_vert). Menu items: 'Cycle count', 'Export'.
Observed the resulting UI state (checked for any Column Chooser panel/dialog and for Cycle Count mode).
actual_now: Selecting 'Cycle count' correctly initiated the Cycle Count workflow: the inventory grid switched into count mode showing a 'Count' input column per row, Save/Cancel buttons, and 'Count changes available: 200'. No Column Chooser panel or dialog/menu opened (verified programmatically - no column-chooser dialog/menu present). Column visibility was unchanged. This matches expected_after_fix.
notes: Event-misfire is gone; Cycle Count starts as expected and does not trigger the Column Chooser.
